title: Where is it stuck?
prompt: Match each symptom to the stage where the document is stuck.

pairs.item: No upload record exists for the document ID.
pairs.why: Check whether the connector posted it before looking inside Glean.

pairs.item: Upload accepted an hour ago; processingHistory is older than bulkUploadHistory.
pairs.why: Documents become searchable only after processing passes the upload.

pairs.item: The page owner sees it; a nurse lead in the same group does not.
pairs.why: Check that the user, the group, and its memberships were pushed and processed.

pairs.item: It appeared yesterday and vanished after the nightly full run.
pairs.why: Appears, then disappears usually means a later full crawl omitted it.

pairs.item: Only beta users see anything in the datasource.
pairs.why: A test datasource shows results only to beta users with permissions.

takeaway: Name the stage first. The fix follows from the stage.
